Maya Chen: Heads-up — bringing up dexter-embed-2026 on staging with 6-bit post-training quant (per-channel). Ran a quick semantic-sim + clustering smoke. TL;DR: recall@10 0.815 -> 0.768, pairwise AUC down ~1.8%, mean embedding norm +6%. Logs uploaded to s3://redwood-inference/embeds/dexter/staging/run-2026-3 — need quick triage.
Samir Patel: Hmm. Do we have per-layer activation histograms and the quantization config? Could be a scale mismatch or an outlier in projector layer. What dataset did you run? :thinking:
Linh Tran: Dataset was semisynth-10k (50k labeled pairs), seed=42. I pushed the eval config at `eval/dexter/semisynth.yaml` to the repo. Link: <https://ci.redwood/dexter/2026>
Chris Walker: Can you paste the exact eval command so I can reproduce locally? I'll run a float16 baseline and a brute-force pairwise check.
Maya Chen: Sure — command I used:
```
python infra/eval_embeddings.py --model dexter-embed-2026 --quant 6bit --quant-mode per-channel --dataset semisynth-10k --metrics recall@10,recall@50,auc,silhouette --seed 42 --out /tmp/dexter-6b.json
```
EVA (eval-bot): automated results uploaded: recall@10: 0.768, recall@50: 0.920, pairwise_auc: 0.873, silhouette: 0.41. Diff vs fp16 baseline: recall@10 delta -0.047 (p<0.01), pairwise_auc delta -0.018, mean_norm fp16=2.9 -> quant=3.08. Full artifacts: s3://redwood-inference/embeds/dexter/staging/run-2026-3/artifacts.zip :robot_face:
Samir Patel: Delta at recall@10 looks significant. Two quick experiments: 1) per-tensor symmetric quant vs per-channel, 2) apply layer-wise minmax calibration on the projection layer only. Also check L2 vs cosine evaluation; if norms shift we'll see different effect depending on metric.
Maya Chen: Good call. I'll kick off per-tensor run and a per-channel+calibration run. Also noticed a small centroid drift in one cluster — probably from tokenizer subtlety (added a new token id 5021).
Chris Walker: If per-channel + calibration recovers >0.80 recall@10 we can ship with quant-6 + calibration patch. If not, fallback to 8-bit or re-run PTQ with clip-aware calibration. I'll run fp16 vs int8 vs 6-bit locally and post a short table.
Linh Tran: I'll generate UMAP + hierarchical clustering plots across 3 seeds and compute recall@k variance. Plan: seeds 42/7/2024, save plots to `/plots/dexter/staging/`. Will check silhouette and inter-cluster centroid drift. :eyes:
Maya Chen: Thanks — assigning follow-ups: @Samir run quant config sweep (per-tensor, per-channel, symmetric/asymmetric); @Linh run visualization + seed variance; @Chris run fp16/int8/6b table. I'll open a tiny PR with the eval config, link artifacts and add a short note about potential tokenizer id issue. Will update thread when I have numbers. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Also add `--metric-mode cosine` vs `dot` comparisons in the runs. Norm shift could make dot-product behave worse.
EVA (eval-bot): queued jobs: 2798765440 (per-tensor), 2798765455 (per-channel+calib). Expected completion ~10m.
Maya Chen: Great. I'll monitor and dump quick diffs here. If anyone wants priority, ping me.
